instructions: Replace every pending status with apply plus decision and evidence, or skip plus reason. Keep names and structure unchanged.

methods.name: domain-modeling

methods.name: how

methods.name: architect

methods.name: arena

methods.name: codebase-design

pstack_principles.name: principle-boundary-discipline
pstack_principles.decision: Parse METHOD.json and FLOW.json once at the hook boundary and pass validated records inward.

pstack_principles.name: principle-build-the-lever
pstack_principles.decision: Use one installed canary driver to reproduce lifecycle, transition, and recovery paths.

pstack_principles.name: principle-encode-lessons-in-structure
pstack_principles.decision: Encode complete method accounting and independent principle assessment in validators and regressions.

pstack_principles.name: principle-exhaust-the-design-space
pstack_principles.decision: Choose the obligation graph and transition ledger after comparing three distinct enforcement designs.

pstack_principles.name: principle-experience-first
pstack_principles.decision: Warn on degraded memory without disabling normal commands or method recovery.

pstack_principles.name: principle-fix-root-causes
pstack_principles.decision: Replace shell and path classification with workflow transition validation.

pstack_principles.name: principle-foundational-thinking
pstack_principles.decision: Separate immutable method policy, mutable transition progress, cross-cutting principle assessments, and append-only memory.

pstack_principles.name: principle-guard-the-context-window
pstack_principles.decision: Inject exact sources at engagement and compact restoration, then use a short workflow card on later turns.

pstack_principles.name: principle-laziness-protocol
pstack_principles.decision: Keep Bash and file paths outside method authorization and add no model call to a hook.

pstack_principles.name: principle-make-operations-idempotent
pstack_principles.decision: Make repeated lifecycle calls converge while stale continuation tokens fail with a current recovery command.

pstack_principles.name: principle-migrate-callers-then-delete-legacy-apis
pstack_principles.reason: This repair changes lifecycle state and does not introduce a replacement internal API.

pstack_principles.name: principle-minimize-reader-load
pstack_principles.decision: Keep method obligations and principle assessment behind separate validators consumed by one FLOW loader.

pstack_principles.name: principle-model-the-domain
pstack_principles.decision: Represent workflow state as frames, method receipts, obligations, a transition epoch, and principle assessments.

pstack_principles.name: principle-never-block-on-the-human
pstack_principles.decision: Keep reversible recovery automatic and reserve blocking for stale method state at a repository write boundary.

pstack_principles.name: principle-outcome-oriented-execution
pstack_principles.reason: This repair is a bug fix, not a planned rewrite or migration with temporary breakage.

pstack_principles.name: principle-prove-it-works
pstack_principles.decision: Verify the installed hooks through fresh, handoff, failed-memory, and repeated-compact canaries.

pstack_principles.name: principle-redesign-from-first-principles
pstack_principles.decision: Treat compaction continuity as part of the workflow model instead of another command classifier.

pstack_principles.name: principle-separate-before-serializing-shared-state
pstack_principles.decision: Keep per-session readiness outside the repository and bind unlazy completion to one named scope.

pstack_principles.name: principle-sequence-verifiable-units
pstack_principles.decision: Close schema, transition, compact, install, and full-check units in order.

pstack_principles.name: principle-subtract-before-you-add
pstack_principles.decision: Remove Bash enforcement, path authorization, and method-owned principles before adding transition checks.

pstack_principles.name: principle-type-system-discipline
pstack_principles.reason: The touched runtime is Python and has no static type checker in this repository.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-codebase-glossary
supplemental_principles.decision: Use module, interface, seam, adapter, depth, leverage, and locality consistently in the guard design.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-codebase-depth
supplemental_principles.decision: Keep lifecycle complexity behind the engagement and FLOW interfaces.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-codebase-principles
supplemental_principles.decision: Apply the deletion test, the interface test surface, and the two-adapter seam rule to each new module.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-codebase-testability
supplemental_principles.decision: Keep validators pure and test them through the public guard and FLOW loaders.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-codebase-relationships
supplemental_principles.decision: Keep one interface per module and place adapters only at real lifecycle seams.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-codebase-rejected-framings
supplemental_principles.decision: Judge module depth by hidden policy, not implementation line count.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-codebase-going-deeper
supplemental_principles.decision: Load the exact deepening and design-it-twice references with the principle stack.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-deepening-dependencies
supplemental_principles.decision: Treat the hook adapter as local infrastructure and the validators as in-process modules.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-deepening-seams
supplemental_principles.decision: Keep the client adapter thin while the shared state interface owns policy.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-deepening-tests
supplemental_principles.decision: Test observable guard outcomes instead of internal helper call order.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-design-it-twice
supplemental_principles.decision: Retain the comparison of the allowlist, duplicated phase machine, and path-independent continuity designs.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-tdd-good-tests
supplemental_principles.decision: Assert user-visible permission and lifecycle behavior through public hook events.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-tdd-seams
supplemental_principles.decision: Use UserPromptSubmit, PreToolUse, SessionStart, PreCompact, and Stop as the agreed test seams.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-tdd-antipatterns
supplemental_principles.decision: Reject implementation-coupled, tautological, and horizontally sliced tests.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-tdd-loop
supplemental_principles.decision: Keep each regression red before its smallest green change and defer refactoring to review.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-test-quality
supplemental_principles.decision: Use independent expected values and observable behavior in every new hook test.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-mocking-boundaries
supplemental_principles.decision: Fake only filesystem, process, and lifecycle boundaries in the hook tests.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-writing-context
supplemental_principles.decision: Use route and compact pointers that name the exact condition for loading their sources.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-writing-loads
supplemental_principles.decision: Keep the full packet at route entry and compact restore, then use a short workflow card.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-writing-hierarchy
supplemental_principles.decision: Keep ordered steps in method obligations and cross-cutting rules in the principle stack.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-writing-completion
supplemental_principles.decision: Give every workflow obligation a source anchor, outcome, dependency, and closure evidence.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-writing-split
supplemental_principles.decision: Split policy modules by owned knowledge while keeping one FLOW interface.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-writing-leading-words
supplemental_principles.decision: Use method, obligation, frame, receipt, checkpoint, and continuation as stable domain terms.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-writing-pruning
supplemental_principles.decision: Keep one source for each rule and remove copied shell and path classifiers.

supplemental_principles.name: pocock-implementation-checks
supplemental_principles.decision: Run focused test files during edits and the complete approved suite once at the end.

supplemental_principles.name: akita-code-style
supplemental_principles.decision: Keep touched production functions short, files below 500 lines, names specific, and types explicit.

supplemental_principles.name: akita-comments
supplemental_principles.decision: Preserve decision comments and remove narration from the changed hook code.

supplemental_principles.name: akita-tests
supplemental_principles.decision: Give new behavior a focused regression and keep tests fast, independent, repeatable, and self-validating.

supplemental_principles.name: akita-dependencies
supplemental_principles.reason: This repair adds no third-party dependency or external service adapter.

supplemental_principles.name: akita-structure
supplemental_principles.decision: Keep hook policy in focused modules under the existing template and installed paths.

supplemental_principles.name: akita-formatting
supplemental_principles.decision: Use the repository Python formatting and unittest conventions without adding a style process.

supplemental_principles.name: akita-logging
supplemental_principles.reason: The hook emits protocol responses and user-facing diagnostics, not application logs.

foundations.name: codebase-design
foundations.decision: Keep lifecycle validation behind one obligation module and expose validated records to adapters.

foundations.decision: Drive installed lifecycle failures through deterministic local fixtures before altering hook policy.
